name: Total generation
definition: Total electricity generated in a country in a given year across all sources.
formula: Sum of generation across all sources (Ember 'Total generation')

name: Renewable share of generation
definition: The percentage of a country's annual electricity generation that comes from renewable sources.
formula: (Hydro + Bioenergy + Wind + Other renewables + Solar) ÷ Total generation × 100

name: Fossil share of generation
definition: The percentage of a country's annual electricity generation that comes from fossil fuels.

name: Carbon intensity of electricity
definition: The greenhouse-gas emissions released per unit of electricity generated in a year.

name: Renewable share of installed capacity
definition: The percentage of a country's installed generating capacity that is renewable.
formula: Renewable capacity ÷ total generating capacity × 100 (large hydro included; see note)

name: Electricity demand per person
definition: The average electricity demand per resident of a country in a given year.
